repos_data.description: TeleMem is a high-performance drop-in replacement for Mem0, featuring semantic deduplication, long-term dialogue memory, and multimodal video reasoning.
Memory layer for AI Agents. Replace complex RAG pipelines with a serverless, single-file memory layer. Give your agents instant retrieval and long-term memory.
Notion MCP server for Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT & Claude Desktop. Connect AI agents to Notion via Model Context Protocol — pages, databases, blocks, comments, files.

Embedded long-term memory database for AI agents & LLM apps. Six-layer cognitive architecture, knowledge graph, hybrid BM25 + vector search, sleep-time memory consolidation. One .meh file, zero infrastructure, pure Go.
Persistent memory MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Long-term memory via Model Context Protocol with semantic search, Git sync, and team collaboration.
Open-source persistent memory for AI agent pipelines (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and Claude. REST API + knowledge graph + autonomous consolidation.
A simple Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates with Notion's API to manage my personal todo list.
Persistent memory system for AI coding assistants via MCP. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline.
Unofficial Notion MCP server via the private API (token_v2) — full read/write, no integration token.
Give your AI agents persistent, collective memory — with deduplicating absorb, supersession lineage, semantic search, and a graph UI. Speaks MCP.
A Model Context Protocol server for connecting Notion to MCP-compatible clients
Governed memory for long-lived coding agents. Trust, provenance, conflict detection. Local-first.

repo_meta_data.description: Sophisticated AI chatbot with long-term memory capabilities, complete Notion workspace integration, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) implementation. Features semantic, episodic, and procedural memory systems.
